test_title: PYST 57: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A x B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A % B means ‘A is the father of B’ and

A # B means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

How is E related to T if ‘T – L # Q # P x E’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63dda41abf2866e49fdde130ab7136e57bda7096925354788bad5b2d737c03d6.png] 

**Given Codes:**

 
 

 
 
 A is 

 
 
 

 +
 -
 × 
 %
 #
 
 

 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 Daughter
 
 
 

 
B is

 
 
 

 

**Expression:**

**T − L # Q # P x E:** E is husband of P. P is mother of Q. Q is mother of L. L is sibling of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e18b68027fbb6433f9490ff8f456e9092c21035eb123e13e28952759feca68d.png] 

Therefore, E is the **grandfather (mother’s father)** of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3".**
